advice_items.quote: Well behaved women rarely make history... you got to break the rules
advice_items.summary_en: Challenge conventions and break the rules instead of playing it safe to achieve major success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于打破常规，不被传统规则束缚

advice_items.quote: Keep asking, keep asking, keep asking... closed mouths don't get fed
advice_items.summary_en: Stay persistent in sales and keep asking because closed mouths don't get fed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 持续主动推销提问，敢开口才有机会

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: I borrow money all the time... I budget it and I spread it out and I multiply it
advice_items.summary_en: Do not fear bank loans; budget borrowed capital carefully, diversify its deployment, and multiply it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用银行贷款做预算并分散投资倍增财富

advice_items.quote: I can make it in 10 phone calls... my network is hefty, big players
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate a powerhouse network of major players so you can rebuild from scratch with a few calls.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造高含金量大玩家人脉圈，关键时刻能东山再起

advice_items.quote: You're going to be a student for life... I'm constantly learning until my last breath
advice_items.summary_en: Listen intently to successful people and remain a lifelong student eager to learn.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善于倾听强者经验，保持终身学习心态

advice_items.quote: File taxes like a billionaire... knowing how to write off... having trust accounts
advice_items.summary_en: Learn proper business accounting, write-offs, portfolios, and trust structures to protect wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 精通商业税务抵扣与信托架构以保全财富

advice_items.quote: When you build the right team they make money for you in your sleep
advice_items.summary_en: Invest heavily in top financial advisors, tax attorneys, and a strong team that earns for you in your sleep.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重金聘请顶尖财税顾问并组建能自动创收的团队

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年从事10年企业客服工作，21岁时在波多黎各机场以佣金形式促成一笔2800万美元的石油大单，此后创立并经营原油开采与太阳能板制造等公司达16年。
guests.wealth_detail: $6M-$7M peak single-year company revenue (self-confirmed millionaire); closed $28M oil deal at age 21
guests.zero_start_advice: 别害怕向银行和机构贷款融资，做好预算将资金分散投入并快速滚动回本；学会倾听并做终身学生，同时组建顶尖财务顾问与税务律师团队合理节税。

advice_items.quote: I would bet on myself every day and twice on Sunday... you got to go all in on yourself
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on yourself wholeheartedly and go all-in when you believe you have a winning advantage.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高度相信自己，看准优势时果断全力押注

advice_items.quote: I'm investor in startups, private equity, hedge funds, stock market, loans... I'm very diversified now
advice_items.summary_en: Preserve and grow post-exit wealth by diversifying across startups, private equity, hedge funds, stocks, and loans.
advice_items.summary_zh: 退出后多元化配置股权、基金、股市与债权资产

advice_items.quote: People that have something to say... sit on the sidelines... the cheap seats are called cheap seats for a reason
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore haters and doubters who sit on the sidelines without doing the actual work.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无视场边看客的风言风语，坚定自我信念

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: I was building a company that was making people's lives happier and healthier
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on building a mission-driven company that genuinely improves customers' health and happiness.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造真正让顾客更健康快乐的高价值事业

advice_items.quote: The number one book that I read every few years is How to Win Friends and Influence People
advice_items.summary_en: Read and periodically revisit foundational classics like Dale Carnegie's How to Win Friends and Influence People.
advice_items.summary_zh: 反复精读《人性的弱点》等经典人际沟通著作

advice_items.quote: Your name is the most important word to you... make sure that you felt seen, at home, respected
advice_items.summary_en: Personalize the customer experience—such as using clients' names—so they feel seen, respected, and eager to return.
advice_items.summary_zh: 直呼顾客姓名等细节营造归属感，提供极致服务

advice_items.quote: Easy choices, hard life; hard choices, easy life... make decisions today that make you proud
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain strict daily health and fitness discipline and make hard choices now for a better long-term life.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持早起健身的高度自律，做难而正确的决定

advice_items.quote: I didn't feel like I sacrificed anything, I loved every part of it
advice_items.summary_en: Love the building journey and your team so deeply that years of hard work never feel like a sacrifice.
advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱创业的每一步，享受过程而不觉牺牲

guests.first_money_or_break: 向Solidcore投入17.5万美元，耗时近10年将其发展为估值超3亿美元的连锁品牌，2023年出售后个人股权价值约9000万至1亿美元。
recommended_books_or_mentors: How to Win Friends and Influence People by Dale Carnegie
guests.role_or_title: Founder & Former Owner of Solidcore; Investor
guests.wealth_detail: $90M equity shares (~$100M total return on $175K invested); Solidcore valued at $300M+ at exit
guests.zero_start_advice: 对自己的独特优势全力以赴并持续复投；不要理会场边看客的质疑，保持极度自律的作息与体能训练，用记住顾客名字等细节赢得客户忠诚。

advice_items.quote: I'm addicted, I love being an entrepreneur... I have 15 companies so it just starts compounding
advice_items.summary_en: Treat entrepreneurship as an exciting game you genuinely love, allowing ventures and momentum to compound.
advice_items.summary_zh: 痴迷并热爱创业过程，让事业随复利不断滚雪球

advice_items.quote: Leisure to me is really getting to do what I love, getting to share it with people I love, and giving back
advice_items.summary_en: Define true fulfillment through doing meaningful work, sharing success with loved ones, and giving back.
advice_items.summary_zh: 与所爱之人分享成果并积极回馈社会

advice_items.quote: Our first company completely failed, we lost everything, and then started It's a 10 with only one bottle
advice_items.summary_en: Bounce back from total business failure and rebuild from whatever minimal resources remain.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从彻底失败和亏光一切中振作，依靠仅剩资源重启

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: I bought my partner out... 100% owned by the original owner, the founder
advice_items.summary_en: Consolidate and retain full founder equity ownership rather than giving up long-term control.
advice_items.summary_zh: 买断股份保留100%创始人股权，掌握长期控制权

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: When you find that organic passion behind a brand and become a worldwide brand built on that, it's priceless
advice_items.summary_en: Create products so genuinely effective that customers and insiders organically champion your brand everywhere.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造好产品赢得自发口碑，用真实热爱铸就全球品牌

advice_items.quote: It's not what you have, it's what you do with what you have
advice_items.summary_en: Stop waiting for ideal resources and execute relentlessly with whatever limited means you currently have.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不纠结现有条件匮乏，最大化利用手中资源行动

advice_items.quote: It's about being more strategic, go where they don't go... bring innovation... zig when they zag and have fun
advice_items.summary_en: Stand out in crowded markets by thinking strategically, innovating, zigging when competitors zag, and enjoying the ride.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用战略创新避开同质化红海，逆向破局并享受过程

guests.first_money_or_break: 深耕美业42年，最初租用4平方英尺工位做独立美发师（1099）；首家公司彻底失败并亏光一切后，仅凭一瓶产品创办“It's a 10”护发品牌，10年后买断合伙人股权实现100%独资，现拥有15家公司。
guests.role_or_title: Founder & 100% Owner of It's a 10 Haircare; Serial Entrepreneur (15 Companies)
guests.wealth_detail: Self-confirmed billionaire; over 9 figures ($100M+) peak single-year revenue; 100% owner of It's a 10 and 15 companies
guests.zero_start_advice: 重要的不是你拥有什么，而是你用现有的东西做什么；竞争激烈时不能只靠努力，要更具战略思维，敢于创新并在别人往左时往右（Zig when they zag），同时在奋斗中享受乐趣。
